lemma approxPoly_bounds {r m k : ℕ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hm : 2 * r ≤ m)
    (hk : 4 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m ≤ (k : ℝ) * Real.sqrt ((r : ℝ) / m)) :
    (approxPoly r m k).natDegree ≤ r + k ∧
    weight R (approxPoly r m k) ≤ (1 + R) ^ r * (7 + 4 * R) ^ k ∧
    (approxPoly r m k).eval 0 = 1 ∧
    ∀ x : ℕ, 1 ≤ x → x ≤ m →
      |(approxPoly r m k).eval (x : ℝ)| ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(3 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m)) := by
  have hrR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hmR : 2 * (r : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hrm : (r : ℝ) < m := by linarith
  have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < m := by linarith
  have hden := chebyshev_denominator k (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hrR) hrm
  let den := (Polynomial.Chebyshev.T ℝ k).eval (((m : ℝ) + r) / (m - r))
  have hd1 : 1 ≤ den := hden.1
  have hd0 : 0 < den := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hd1
  have hdb : Real.exp (4 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m) / 2 ≤ den :=
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.2 hk) (by norm_num)).trans hden.2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply natDegree_mul_le.trans
    apply add_le_add
    · exact (natDegree_C_mul_le _ _).trans (rootPoly_degree r)
    · apply natDegree_comp_le.trans
      simpa only [Polynomial.Chebyshev.natDegree_T, Int.natAbs_natCast, mul_one] using
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left k (scalePoly_degree r m)
  · apply (weight_mul_le hR _ _).trans
    apply mul_le_mul _ _ (weight_nonneg hR _) (by positivity)
    · apply (weight_mul_le hR _ _).trans
      rw [weight_C, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hd0)]
      exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (weight_nonneg hR _) (inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hd1)).trans
        (rootPoly_weight hR r)
    · apply (weight_chebyshev hR _ k).trans
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by have := weight_nonneg hR (scalePoly r m); linarith)
      have := scalePoly_weight hR hrR hmR
      linarith
  · simp only [approxPoly, eval_mul, eval_C, rootPoly_eval_zero, mul_one,
      eval_comp, scalePoly_zero]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hd0)
  · intro x hx0 hxm
    by_cases hxr : x ≤ r
    · simp only [approxPoly, eval_mul, rootPoly_eval_nat hx0 hxr, mul_zero, zero_mul,
        abs_zero]
      positivity
    have hrx : (r : ℝ) ≤ x := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge hxr))
    have hxmR : (x : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hxm
    have hroot := rootPoly_abs_eval (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ m by linarith)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg x) hxmR r
    have hcheb := chebyshev_abs_le_one k (scalePoly_interval hrm hrx hxmR)
    have heq : (approxPoly r m k).eval (x : ℝ) =
        den⁻¹ * (rootPoly r).eval (x : ℝ) *

      simp only [approxPoly, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_comp, den]
    rw [heq, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.2 hd0)]
    apply (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hroot (le_of_lt (inv_pos.2 hd0)))

    rw [mul_one, inv_mul_eq_div]
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hd0).2
    have epos : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(3 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m)) := by positivity
    apply (le_trans ?_ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdb epos))
    rw [show 2 * Real.exp (-(3 * (r : ℝ) * Real.log m)) *

lemma small_support_layer_bound {N : ℕ} (V : Operator N) (hV : V ∈ unitary (Operator N))
    (R : ReflectionLayer N) (L : LocalLayer N) (M A : Count N) {r r₁ r₂ δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h₁ : ∀ D : Count N, ‖M.high r₁*conjugate V D.zero*M.zero‖ ≤ δ)
    (h₂ : ∀ D : Count N, ‖M.high r₂*conjugate V D.zero*M.low r₁‖ ≤ δ)
    (h₃ : ∀ D : Count N, ‖M.high r*conjugate V D.zero*M.low r₂‖ ≤ δ) :
    ‖M.high r*conjugate (V*reflectionMatrix R*localMatrix L) A.zero*M.zero‖ ≤
      (9:ℝ)^A.support.card*(3*δ) := by
  have hc : ∀ D : Count N, ‖conjugate V D.zero‖ ≤ 1 := fun D =>
    IsStarProjection.norm_le _ (conjugate_projection hV D.zero_projection)
  have htriple : ∀ X Y Z : Count N,
      ‖M.high r*conjugate V X.zero*conjugate V Y.zero*conjugate V Z.zero*M.zero‖ ≤ 3*δ := by
    intro X Y Z
    exact three_factor_transition _ _ (M.high r₁) (M.high r₂) _ _ _
      (IsStarProjection.norm_le _ (M.high_projection r)) (IsStarProjection.norm_le _ M.zero_projection)
      (IsStarProjection.norm_le _ (M.low_projection r₁)) (hc X) (hc Y) (hc Z) (h₁ Z) (h₂ Y) (h₃ X)
  have hbound := reflection_transition_bound (R.active (A.rotate L)) V (M.high r) M.zero
    (A.rotate L) hV (3*δ) (fun X Y => htriple X (A.rotate L) Y)
  have hlen : (R.active (A.rotate L)).gates.length ≤ A.support.card := R.active_length (A.rotate L)
  calc
    _ = ‖M.high r*conjugate V (conjugate (reflectionMatrix (R.active (A.rotate L))) (A.rotate L).zero)*M.zero‖ := by
      rw [conjugate_comp,conjugate_comp,
        show conjugate (localMatrix L) A.zero = (A.rotate L).zero from (A.rotate_zero L).symm,
        R.active_conjugate]
    _ ≤ (9:ℝ)^(R.active (A.rotate L)).gates.length*(3*δ) := hbound
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hlen) (by positivity)

theorem expLevel_domain_bound {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) {ι : Type u_144} [Fintype ι]
    (v : ι → ℂ) (b : ι → ℝ) (hc : IsCompact {z | Geometry.expLevel v b z ≤ 1})
    (hW : ∀ z ∈ numericalRange A, Geometry.expLevel v b z < 1)
    (F : MatrixPolynomial m)
    (hF : ∀ z, Geometry.expLevel v b z ≤ 1 → ‖matrixPolynomialValue z F‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖tensorPolynomial A F‖ ≤ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := numericalRange_nonempty hn A
  obtain ⟨R,hR,c,g,hc0,hg,hinj,hder,hcircle,hout⟩ :=
    Geometry.exists_expLevel_exterior v b hc (hW a ha)
  have hge (ζ : ℂ) (hζ : 1 ≤ ‖ζ‖) : 1 ≤ Geometry.expLevel v b (Faber.exterior c g ζ) := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hζ with he|hl
    · exact le_of_eq (hcircle ζ he.symm).symm
    · exact le_of_lt (hout ζ hl)
  have hs (t : Faber.Angle) (w : ℂ) (hw : Geometry.expLevel v b w ≤ 1) :
      0 ≤ (conj (Faber.boundaryNormal c g t)*(Faber.boundary c g t-w)).re := by
    have hdt := Faber.hasDerivAt_exterior hg c (Faber.unitPoint_ne_zero t) (Faber.unitPoint_inv_mem hR t)
    have hh := Geometry.expLevel_holomorphic_support v b (hW a ha) (Faber.unitPoint_norm t)
      hdt.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt (hder _ (Faber.unitPoint_ne_zero t) (Faber.unitPoint_inv_mem hR t)) hcircle hge hw
    have he : Faber.unitPoint t*deriv (Faber.exterior c g) (Faber.unitPoint t) = Faber.boundaryNormal c g t := by
      rw [hdt.deriv]; rfl
    rw [he,real_inner_eq_re_inner ℂ,RCLike.inner_apply] at hh
    change 0 ≤ ((Faber.exterior c g (Faber.unitPoint t)-w)*conj (Faber.boundaryNormal c g t)).re at hh
    simpa only [Faber.boundary,mul_comm] using hh
  apply exterior_collar_bound hn hm A hR hg hc0 hinj hder
  · intro t s
    exact hs t _ (le_of_eq (hcircle _ (Faber.unitPoint_norm s)))
  · intro ζ hζ hz
    have h1 := hge ζ hζ
    have h2 := hW _ hz
    linarith
  · intro t w hw
    exact hs t w (le_of_lt (hW w hw))
  · intro t
    exact hF _ (le_of_eq (hcircle _ (Faber.unitPoint_norm t)))

theorem analytic_domain_core {n m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hm : 0 < m)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (hb0 : b 0 = 1)
    (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
    (hexpand : ∀ G : MatrixPolynomial m, ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      G = faberPolynomial b C)
    (hlower : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C))
    (hupper : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C) ≤ ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k))
    (R : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff R (-(k : ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (b k))
    (hposfreq : ∀ k : ℤ, 0 < k → fourierCoeff R k = 0)

    (F : MatrixPolynomial m) (hF : ∀ t, ‖matrixPolynomialValue (h t) F‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖tensorPolynomial A F‖ ≤ 2 := by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hn⟩
  let : NeZero m := ⟨Nat.ne_of_gt hm⟩
  let γ := ‖tensorPolynomial A F‖
  by_cases hγ0 : γ = 0
  · change γ ≤ 2
    rw [hγ0]
    norm_num
  have hγ : 0 < γ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hγ0)
  let T := Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F)
  have hT : ‖T‖ = γ := Matrix.l2_opNorm_toEuclideanCLM _
  obtain ⟨x,y,hx,hy,hxy,hyx⟩ := exists_singular_pair T (hT ▸ hγ)
  rw [hT] at hxy hyx
  let X := matrixify x
  let Y := matrixify y
  have hFx : T (hsVector X) = (γ : ℂ) • hsVector Y := by simpa only [X,Y,hsVector_matrixify] using hxy
  have hFy : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T (hsVector Y) = (γ : ℂ) • hsVector X := by
    simpa only [X,Y,hsVector_matrixify] using hyx
  let P := fun t => Xᴴ * R t * X
  let Q := fun t => Yᴴ * R t * Y
  let M := fun t => Yᴴ * R t * X
  let L := fun t => Xᴴ * R t * Y
  have hC (U V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) :
      Continuous (fun t => Vᴴ * R t * U) := (compressionCLM U V).continuous.comp hR
  have hCp (U V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (k : ℤ) (hk : 0 < k) :
      fourierCoeff (fun t => Vᴴ * R t * U) k = 0 := by
    rw [fourierCoeff_compression U V R hR,hposfreq k hk]
    simp
  have hCc (U V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
      fourierCoeff (fun t => Vᴴ * R t * U) (-(k : ℤ)) = Vᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b k) * U := by
    rw [fourierCoeff_compression U V R hR,hcoeff]
  have hC0 (U V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) :
      fourierCoeff (fun t => Vᴴ * R t * U) 0 = Vᴴ * U := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_zero,neg_zero,hb0,map_one,Matrix.mul_one] using hCc U V 0
  let a := ∫ t, hsSq (M t) ∂circleMeasure
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := integral_nonneg (fun _ => hsSq_nonneg _)
  have hapos : 0 < a := by
    have hv := cross_boundary_estimate A b h hexpand hlower R hR hcoeff X Y F
    change ‖inner ℂ (hsVector Y) (T (hsVector X))‖^2 ≤ a * polynomialEnergy h F at hv
    have hyHS : ‖hsVector Y‖ = 1 := by simpa only [Y,hsVector_matrixify] using hy
    rw [hFx,inner_smul_right,inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K,hyHS] at hv

    rw [ha0,zero_mul] at hv
    have hv' : γ^2 ≤ 0 := by simpa using hv
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hγ]

  change (_ ≤ a/γ^2) ∧ (_ ≤ a/γ^2) at hdiag
  have hPE : (∫ t, hsSq (P t + (P t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure) ≤ 4*a/γ^2 := by
    rw [anti_diagonal_energy P (hC X X) (hCp X X)]
    · have hc0 := hCc X X 0
      have hcs (k : ℕ) := hCc X X (k+1)
      simp only [Int.natCast_zero,neg_zero,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] at hc0 hcs
      simp_rw [show P = (fun t => Xᴴ * R t * X) from rfl,hc0,hcs]
      simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiag.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)
    · rw [hC0 X X]
      exact Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self X
  have hQE : (∫ t, hsSq (Q t + (Q t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure) ≤ 4*a/γ^2 := by
    rw [anti_diagonal_energy Q (hC Y Y) (hCp Y Y)]
    · have hc0 := hCc Y Y 0
      have hcs (k : ℕ) := hCc Y Y (k+1)
      simp only [Int.natCast_zero,neg_zero,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] at hc0 hcs
      simp_rw [show Q = (fun t => Yᴴ * R t * Y) from rfl,hc0,hcs]
      simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdiag.2 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)
    · rw [hC0 Y Y]
      exact Matrix.isHermitian_conjTranspose_mul_self Y
  have hME : a ≤ ∫ t, hsSq (M t + (L t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure := by
    apply anti_cross_energy M L (hC X Y) (hC Y X) (hCp X Y) (hCp Y X)
    rw [hC0 Y X,hC0 X Y]
    simp
  have hEcont (U V U' V' : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) :
      Continuous (fun t => hsSq (Vᴴ * R t * U + (V'ᴴ * R t * U')ᴴ)) :=
    continuous_hsSq.comp ((hC U V).add (conjugateTransposeCLM.continuous.comp (hC U' V')))
  have hpi := continuous_integrable_compact circleMeasure (hEcont X X X X)
  have hqi := continuous_integrable_compact circleMeasure (hEcont Y Y Y Y)
  have hmi := continuous_integrable_compact circleMeasure (hEcont X Y Y X)
  have hblock : 2 * (∫ t, hsSq (M t + (L t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure) ≤
      (∫ t, hsSq (P t + (P t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure) +
      ∫ t, hsSq (Q t + (Q t)ᴴ) ∂circleMeasure := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul,← integral_add hpi hqi]
    exact integral_mono (hmi.const_mul 2) (hpi.add hqi)
      (fun t => positive_block_hsSq (positive_compression_blocks (R t) X Y (hpositive t)))
  have hb : 2*a ≤ 8*a/γ^2 := by
    simp only [mul_div_assoc] at hPE hQE ⊢
    linarith
  have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hγ)).mp hb
  change γ ≤ 2
  have hg2 : γ^2 ≤ 4 := by nlinarith [hapos]
  nlinarith

theorem expLevel_holomorphic_support {ι : Type u_143} [Fintype ι]
    (v : ι → ℂ) (b : ι → ℝ) {a : ℂ} (ha : expLevel v b a < 1)
    {ψ : ℂ → ℂ} {ζ : ℂ} (hζ : ‖ζ‖ = 1)
    (hd : HasDerivAt ψ (deriv ψ ζ) ζ) (hdn : deriv ψ ζ ≠ 0)
    (hcircle : ∀ η : ℂ, ‖η‖ = 1 → expLevel v b (ψ η) = 1)
    (hout : ∀ η : ℂ, 1 ≤ ‖η‖ → 1 ≤ expLevel v b (ψ η))
    {w : ℂ} (hw : expLevel v b w ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ inner ℝ (ζ*deriv ψ ζ) (ψ ζ-w) := by
  let G := expGradient v b (ψ ζ)
  let q := ζ*deriv ψ ζ
  have hζ0 : ζ ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp [hh] at hζ
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hζ0 hdn
  have hlevel : expLevel v b (ψ ζ) = 1 := hcircle ζ hζ
  have hG : G ≠ 0 := expGradient_ne_zero v b hlevel ha
  have hφd : HasFDerivAt (expLevel v b) (innerSL ℝ G) (ψ ζ) := expLevel_hasFDerivAt v b (ψ ζ)
  have horth : inner ℝ G (Complex.I*q) = 0 := by
    let e := fun t : ℝ => ζ*Complex.exp ((t:ℂ)*Complex.I)
    have he0 : e 0 = ζ := by simp [e]
    have hed : HasDerivAt e (ζ*Complex.I) 0 := by
      have hi : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t:ℂ)) 1 0 := by
        simpa only [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply,Complex.ofReal_one] using! (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := (0:ℝ)))
      convert! ((hi.mul_const Complex.I).cexp).const_mul ζ using 1 ; simp
    have hψd := (show HasDerivAt ψ (deriv ψ ζ) (e 0) from he0 ▸ hd).scomp 0 hed
    have hcomp := (show HasFDerivAt (expLevel v b) (innerSL ℝ G) (ψ (e 0)) from he0 ▸ hφd).comp_hasDerivAt 0 hψd
    have hc : (fun t : ℝ => expLevel v b (ψ (e t))) = fun _ => 1 := by
      funext t
      apply hcircle
      simp [e,hζ,Complex.norm_exp]
    have hv : deriv (fun t : ℝ => expLevel v b (ψ (e t))) 0 = 0 := by rw [hc]; simp
    have heval : inner ℝ G (Complex.I*q) = (innerSL ℝ G) ((ζ*Complex.I) • deriv ψ ζ) := by
      simp only [innerSL_apply_apply,smul_eq_mul,q]; congr 1; ring
    rw [heval,← hcomp.deriv]
    exact hv
  have hpos : 0 ≤ inner ℝ G q := by
    let r := fun t : ℝ => (t:ℂ)*ζ
    have hr1 : r 1 = ζ := by simp [r]
    have hrd : HasDerivAt r ζ 1 := by
      have hi : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t:ℂ)) 1 1 := by
        simpa only [Complex.ofRealCLM_apply,Complex.ofReal_one] using! (Complex.ofRealCLM.hasDerivAt (x := (1:ℝ)))
      convert! hi.mul_const ζ using 1 ; simp
    have hψd := (show HasDerivAt ψ (deriv ψ ζ) (r 1) from hr1 ▸ hd).scomp 1 hrd
    have hcomp := (show HasFDerivAt (expLevel v b) (innerSL ℝ G) (ψ (r 1)) from hr1 ▸ hφd).comp_hasDerivAt 1 hψd
    have hmin : IsMinOn (fun t : ℝ => expLevel v b (ψ (r t))) (Ici 1) 1 := by
      intro t ht
      change expLevel v b (ψ (r 1)) ≤ expLevel v b (ψ (r t))
      rw [hr1,hlevel]
      apply hout
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := le_trans (by norm_num) ht
      simpa [r,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg ht0,hζ] using ht
    have htan : (1:ℝ) ∈ posTangentConeAt (Ici 1) 1 := by
      apply mem_posTangentConeAt_of_segment_subset
      exact (convex_Ici (1:ℝ)).segment_subset (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have hh := hmin.isLocalMinOn.hasFDerivWithinAt_nonneg hcomp.hasFDerivAt.hasFDerivWithinAt htan
    simpa [q] using hh
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hqeq⟩ := positive_parallel_of_complex_inner hG hq horth hpos
  have hs := expLevel_first_order v b (ψ ζ) w
  rw [hlevel,show expGradient v b (ψ ζ) = G from rfl] at hs
  have hsupport : 0 ≤ inner ℝ G (ψ ζ-w) := by
    rw [inner_sub_right] at hs ⊢
    linarith
  change 0 ≤ inner ℝ q (ψ ζ-w)
  rw [hqeq,real_inner_smul_left]
  exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt ht) hsupport

theorem faber_hilbert_coefficient_bounds {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 < R) {g : ℂ → ℂ}
    (hg : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g (ball 0 R)) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hH : ∀ u ∈ ball 0 R, ∀ v ∈ ball 0 R, chordDenominator c g u v ≠ 0)
    (hpositive : ∀ t s, 0 ≤ boundaryKernel c g t s)
    {N : ℕ} (C : Fin N → E) :
    (∑ k, ‖C k‖^2 ≤ ∫ t, ‖faberBoundarySeries c g C t‖^2 ∂angularMeasure) ∧
      ((∫ t, ‖faberBoundarySeries c g C t‖^2 ∂angularMeasure) ≤
        ∑ k : Fin N, (if (k:ℕ) = 0 then 1 else 2)*‖C k‖^2) := by
  have hS := continuous_boundaryCorrection hR hg hH
  have hr := continuous_boundaryRemainder c g C hS
  have he : (∫ t, ‖faberBoundarySeries c g C t‖^2 ∂angularMeasure) =

    simp_rw [faberBoundarySeries_decomp hR hg hc hH]

    simp_rw [boundaryKernel_action hR hg hH C,energy_positiveSeries] at ht
    exact ht

theorem singular_diagonal_estimates {n m : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (b : ℕ → Polynomial ℂ) (h : BoundaryCircle → ℂ) (hh : Continuous h)
    (hexpand : ∀ G : MatrixPolynomial m, ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      G = faberPolynomial b C)
    (hlower : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      ∑ k, hsSq (C k) ≤ polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C))
    (hupper : ∀ N (C : Fin N → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ),
      polynomialEnergy h (faberPolynomial b C) ≤ ∑ k : Fin N, faberWeight k * hsSq (C k))
    (R : BoundaryCircle → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hcoeff : ∀ k : ℕ, fourierCoeff R (-(k : ℤ)) = Polynomial.aeval A (b k))
    (F : MatrixPolynomial m) (hF : ∀ t, ‖matrixPolynomialValue (h t) F‖ ≤ 1)
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℂ) (γ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ)
    (hFx : Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F) (hsVector X) =
      (γ : ℂ) • hsVector Y)
    (hFy : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n × Fin m) (𝕜 := ℂ) (tensorPolynomial A F)) (hsVector Y) =

    (hsSq (Yᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b 0) * Y) + (1/2 : ℝ) *
      ∑' k : ℕ, hsSq (Yᴴ * Polynomial.aeval A (b (k+1)) * Y) ≤ a / γ^2) := by

theorem finite_support_impossible (hp : 1 ≤ p) (S : Finset (Block p)) (ho : base p ∈ S)
    (T : FreeSpace (base p) →L[ℝ] FreeSpace (base p))
    (hn : ‖T‖ ≤ 2*(p : ℝ))
    (hfixed : ∀ u, supportProjection (base p) (separation p) S (T u) = T u)
    (he : ∀ a ∈ anchors p, ‖T (delta (base p) a) - delta (base p) a‖ < 1) : False := by
  let compatible : Vertices p → S → Prop := fun x j =>
    MetricBlock.Compatible (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) (L p) (K p) x j.val
  let trans : S → S → Prop := fun j k =>
    MetricBlock.Transition (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) (L p) j.val k.val
  let P : S → Finset (Colors p) := fun j =>
    MetricBlock.supportColors (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) j.val
  have hcolor : ∀ x j, compatible x j → color p x ∈ P j := by
    intro x j hj
    exact MetricBlock.compatible_color (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) (L p) (K p)
      (compatibility_cap p) x j.val hj
  obtain ⟨n,_,hnrare⟩ := GraphProducer.exists_rare_component (Generators p) (Colors p) S
    (Q p) (H p) (V p) (Q_pos p) (H_pos p) (by rw [nat_card_ports]; have := degree_ge p; omega)
    (by simpa only [nat_card_ports,nat_card_colors] using colors_large p)
    compatible trans P (fun j => support_colors_bound p j.val) hcolor (transition_bound p hp S)
  let X := (GraphProducer.Cayley (Generators p) n → Colors p) × GraphProducer.Cayley (Generators p) n
  let G := GraphProducer.allColoringsGraph (Generators p) (Colors p) n
  let i : X → Vertices p := GraphProducer.intoSequence (Generators p) (Colors p) n
  let v : X → Block p := fun x => MetricBlock.ofVertex (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) (i x)
  let μ : X → S → ℝ := fun x => affineWeights (base p) (separation p) S ho (T (delta (base p) (v x)))
  let E : X → Ports p → Set S := fun x e =>
    MetricBlock.exceptionSet (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) (L p) (K p) S n (i x) e
  let bad : Finset X := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => ¬ (graph p).Good compatible trans n (i x))
  have hbad : 20*(V p)*(bad.card) < Fintype.card X := by
    have hc : bad.card = Nat.card {x : X // ¬ (graph p).Good compatible trans n (i x)} := by
      rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,Fintype.card_subtype]
    rw [hc,← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact hnrare
  have hrealV : (V p : ℝ) = 1+4*(p : ℝ)*(B p : ℝ) := by simp [V]
  have hTV (x : X) : totalVariation (μ x) ≤ (V p : ℝ) := by
    rw [hrealV]
    exact affineWeights_operator_variation (base p) (separation p) S ho T hfixed p (B p)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hn (fun z => diameter p z (base p)) (v x)
  have hgood (x : X) (hx : x ∉ bad) (j : S) (e f : Ports p)
      (he : j ∈ E x e) (hf : j ∈ E x f) : e = f := by
    have hx' : (graph p).Good compatible trans n (i x) := by
      simpa only [bad,Finset.mem_filter,Finset.mem_univ,true_and,not_not] using hx
    exact MetricBlock.exceptional_unique_good (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) (L p) (K p)
      S n (i x) hx' j e f he hf
  apply signed_incidence_obstruction μ E bad G.incidenceReverse (p : ℝ) (V p : ℝ)
    (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p by omega)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hTV hgood
    (by rw [card_ports]; exact_mod_cast degree_variation p) (by exact_mod_cast hbad)
  rintro ⟨x,e⟩
  change 3*(10*(p : ℝ))/2 - 2*(10*(p : ℝ)) *
    (variationOn (μ x) (E x e) + variationOn (μ (G.move x e)) (E (G.move x e) (G.reverse e))) ≤ 2*(p : ℝ)
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hbound,hfx,hfy⟩ := MetricBlock.edge_test (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) (L p) (K p)
    (L_pos hp) (K_pos hp) (L_le_K p) S n (i x) e
  let b : S → ℝ := fun j => labelBump (MetricBlock.label (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p))
    (MetricBlock.originalLabel (graph p) (color p) (D p) (i x)) (L p) (K p) j.val
  let c : S → ℝ := fun j => labelBump (MetricBlock.label (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p))
    (MetricBlock.originalLabel (graph p) (color p) (D p) (i (G.move x e))) (L p) (K p) j.val
  have hb (j : S) : 0 ≤ b j ∧ b j ≤ (L p : ℝ) :=
    ⟨labelBump_nonneg _ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _,labelBump_le _ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast K_pos hp) _⟩
  have hc (j : S) : 0 ≤ c j ∧ c j ≤ (L p : ℝ) :=
    ⟨labelBump_nonneg _ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _,labelBump_le _ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast K_pos hp) _⟩
  have hlower := opposing_pairing_lower (μ x) (μ (G.move x e)) (fun j : S => f j.val) b c
    (E x e) (E (G.move x e) (G.reverse e)) (L p) (fun j => hbound j.val) hb hc hfx hfy
  have hxmass : 3*(L p : ℝ)/4 ≤ pairing (μ x) b := bump_mass p hp S ho T hn hfixed he (i x)
  have hymass : 3*(L p : ℝ)/4 ≤ pairing (μ (G.move x e)) c := bump_mass p hp S ho T hn hfixed he (i (G.move x e))
  have hdiff := affine_difference_bound (base p) (separation p) S ho T hfixed (2*(p : ℝ)) hn
    f hf (v x) (v (G.move x e))
  have hdist : dist (v x) (v (G.move x e)) ≤ 1 :=
    MetricBlock.source_edge (graph p) (color p) (D p) (R p) (i x) e
  have hupper : pairing (μ x) (fun j : S => f j.val) - pairing (μ (G.move x e)) (fun j : S => f j.val) ≤ 2*(p : ℝ) := by
    apply (le_abs_self _).trans (hdiff.trans _)
    simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdist (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*(p : ℝ))
  have hL : (L p : ℝ) = 10*(p : ℝ) := by simp [L]
  rw [hL] at hxmass hymass hlower
  linarith

theorem rare_matched_bound (n N Q H : ℕ) (hnN : n ≤ N)
    (compatible : ((Cayley A N → C) × Cayley A N) → S → Prop)
    (trans : S → S → Prop) (P : S → Finset C)
    (hP : ∀ j, (P j).card ≤ H)
    (hcolor : ∀ z j, compatible z j → z.1 z.2 ∈ P j)
    (hQ : ∀ j, Fintype.card {k : S // trans j k} ≤ Q) :
    Nat.card {z : (Cayley A N → C) × Cayley A N //
        ¬ (allColoringsGraph A C N).Good compatible trans n z} * Nat.card C ^ (n+1) ≤
      Nat.card (A × Bool) ^ n * (Nat.card S * Q ^ n) * H ^ (n+1) *
        Nat.card ((Cayley A N → C) × Cayley A N) := by
  let W := {w : Words (A × Bool) n // (cayleyGraph A N).Reduced w.val}
  let f : Cayley A N → W → Fin (n+1) → Cayley A N :=
    fun x w i => (cayleyGraph A N).walk x (w.val.val.take i.val)
  have hf : ∀ x w, Function.Injective (f x w) := by
    intro x w i j h
    have hi : i.val < w.val.val.length+1 := by rw [w.val.property]; exact i.isLt
    have hj : j.val < w.val.val.length+1 := by rw [w.val.property]; exact j.isLt
    have hw : w.val.val.length ≤ N := by rw [w.val.property]; exact hnN
    have hh := cayley_prefix_injective A N x w.val.val w.property hw
      (show (cayleyGraph A N).walk x (w.val.val.take (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : Fin (w.val.val.length+1)).val) =
        (cayleyGraph A N).walk x (w.val.val.take (⟨j.val, hj⟩ : Fin (w.val.val.length+1)).val) from h)
    exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun t : Fin (w.val.val.length+1) => t.val) hh)
  let PC : StatePaths.Path trans n → Fin (n+1) → Finset C :=
    fun p i => P (StatePaths.Path.vertex trans p i)
  let B := {z : (Cayley A N → C) × Cayley A N //
    ¬ (allColoringsGraph A C N).Good compatible trans n z}
  let E := {z : (Cayley A N → C) × Cayley A N //
    ∃ w p, ∀ i, z.1 (f z.2 w i) ∈ PC p i}
  have hBE : Nat.card B ≤ Nat.card E := by
    let emb : B → E := fun z => ⟨z.val, by
      have hz := z.property
      simp only [PortGraph.Good, not_forall, not_not] at hz
      obtain ⟨j, w, hw, hr, hm⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := PortGraph.Matched.exists_based (allColoringsGraph A C N)
        compatible trans hm
      subst n
      refine ⟨⟨⟨w, rfl⟩, hr⟩, ⟨j, p⟩, fun i => ?_⟩
      have hpi := hp i
      rw [allColorings_walk] at hpi
      exact hcolor _ _ hpi⟩
    exact Nat.card_le_card_of_injective emb (by
      intro x y h
      exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : E => z.val) h))
  have hcount := ColorCounting.colored_roots_bound f hf PC H (fun p i => hP (StatePaths.Path.vertex trans p i))
  simp only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_fin] at hcount
  have hW : Nat.card W ≤ Nat.card (A × Bool) ^ n := by
    have hh := Fintype.card_le_of_injective (fun w : W => w.val) Subtype.val_injective
    rw [Words.card] at hh
    simpa only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hh
  have hS := StatePaths.card_path_le trans Q hQ n
  simp only [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] at hS
  calc
    _ ≤ Nat.card E * Nat.card C ^ (n+1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hBE
    _ ≤ Nat.card W * Nat.card (StatePaths.Path trans n) * H ^ (n+1) *
        Nat.card ((Cayley A N → C) × Cayley A N) := hcount
    _ ≤ _ := by gcongr

theorem exists_rare_component (Q H V : ℕ) (hQpos : 0 < Q) (hHpos : 0 < H)
    (hDpos : 0 < Nat.card (A × Bool))
    (hk : 2 * Nat.card (A × Bool) * Q * H < Nat.card C)
    (compatible : Vertex A C → S → Prop) (trans : S → S → Prop) (P : S → Finset C)
    (hP : ∀ j, (P j).card ≤ H)
    (hcolor : ∀ z j, compatible z j → sequenceColor A C z ∈ P j)
    (hQ : ∀ j, Fintype.card {k : S // trans j k} ≤ Q) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 2 ≤ n ∧
      20 * V * Nat.card {z : (Cayley A n → C) × Cayley A n //
        ¬ (sequenceGraph A C).Good compatible trans n (intoSequence A C n z)} <
      Nat.card ((Cayley A n → C) × Cayley A n) := by
  let d := Nat.card (A × Bool)
  let k := Nat.card C
  let s := Nat.card S
  let q := d*Q*H
  have hq : 0 < q := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos hDpos hQpos) hHpos
  have hk' : 2*q < k := by simpa only [q, d, k, Nat.mul_assoc] using hk
  have hkp : 0 < k := lt_trans (by omega) hk'
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := pow_unbounded_of_one_lt (20*V*s*H) (by norm_num : 1 < (2 : ℕ))
  let n := m+2
  have hn : 20*V*s*H < 2^n := hm.trans_le (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by dsimp [n]; omega))
  have hcoeff : 20*V*(d^n*(s*Q^n)*H^(n+1)) < k^(n+1) := by
    calc
      _ = (20*V*s*H) * q^n := by dsimp [q]; simp only [mul_pow, pow_succ]; ring
      _ < 2^n * q^n := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hn (pow_pos hq n)
      _ = (2*q)^n := (mul_pow ..).symm
      _ ≤ k^n := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hk'.le n
      _ ≤ k^(n+1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hkp (Nat.le_succ _)
  have hcount := rare_matched_bound A C S n n Q H le_rfl
    (fun z => compatible (intoSequence A C n z)) trans P hP
    (fun z j hj => hcolor _ _ hj) hQ
  have heq : {z : (Cayley A n → C) × Cayley A n //
      ¬ (allColoringsGraph A C n).Good (fun z => compatible (intoSequence A C n z)) trans n z} =
      {z : (Cayley A n → C) × Cayley A n //
      ¬ (sequenceGraph A C).Good compatible trans n (intoSequence A C n z)} := by
    congr 1
    funext z
    exact propext (not_congr (sequence_good A C compatible trans n n z).symm)
  rw [heq] at hcount
  change _ * k^(n+1) ≤ d^n*(s*Q^n)*H^(n+1)*_ at hcount
  have hroot : 0 < Nat.card ((Cayley A n → C) × Cayley A n) := Nat.card_pos
  refine ⟨n, by dsimp [n]; omega, ?_⟩
  by_contra h
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (k^(n+1)) (Nat.le_of_not_gt h)
  have hc := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (20*V) hcount
  have hf := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hcoeff hroot
  nlinarith

theorem affine_bump_mass (o : M)
    (sep : ∀ x y : M, x ≠ y → 1 ≤ dist x y) (S : Finset M) (ho : o ∈ S)
    (T : FreeSpace o →L[ℝ] FreeSpace o)
    (hfixed : ∀ u, supportProjection o sep S (T u) = T u)
    (h : M → N) (hh : LipschitzWith 1 h) (x a : M) (ha : h a = h x)
    (L K p R : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hK : 0 < K) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (hn : ‖T‖ ≤ 2*p) (hR : dist x a ≤ R) (he : ‖T (delta o a) - delta o a‖ < 1) :
    L - (L/K)*(2*p*R+1) ≤
      pairing (affineWeights o sep S ho (T (delta o x)))
        (fun j : S => labelBump h (h x) L K j.val) := by
  let b := labelBump h (h x) L K
  have hb (s t : M) : |b s - b t| ≤ (L/K)*dist s t := labelBump_sub h hh (h x) hL hK s t
  let f := Lip0.center o b (L/K) (div_nonneg hL hK.le) hb
  have hfn : ‖f‖ ≤ L/K := Lip0.center_norm_le o b _ _ hb
  have hda : ‖T (delta o x) - delta o a‖ ≤ 2*p*R+1 := by
    calc
      _ = ‖T (delta o x - delta o a) + (T (delta o a) - delta o a)‖ := by rw [map_sub]; congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖T (delta o x - delta o a)‖ + ‖T (delta o a) - delta o a‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (2*p)*R + 1 := add_le_add
        ((T.le_opNorm _).trans (mul_le_mul hn (by simpa using hR) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))) he.le
  have heq := affineWeights_pairing o sep S ho (T (delta o x)) (hfixed _) b (L/K)
    (div_nonneg hL hK.le) hb
  have hba : b a = L := labelBump_self h (h x) ha
  have hpair : pairing (affineWeights o sep S ho (T (delta o x))) (fun j : S => b j.val) - L =
      dualPairing o f (T (delta o x) - delta o a) := by
    rw [heq, map_sub, dualPairing_delta]
    change _ = _ - (b a - b o)
    rw [hba]
    ring
  have heval := (dualPairing_bound o f (T (delta o x) - delta o a)).trans
    (mul_le_mul hda hfn (norm_nonneg _) ((norm_nonneg _).trans hda))
  rw [← hpair] at heval
  have hh := (abs_le.mp heval).1
  change L - _ ≤ pairing _ (fun j : S => b j.val)
  nlinarith

theorem edge_test (hL : 0 < L) (hK : 0 < K) (hLK : L ≤ K)
    (S : Finset (Point G color cap R)) (n : ℕ) (x : X) (e : E) :
    ∃ f : Point G color cap R → ℝ, LipschitzWith 1 f ∧ (∀ z, |f z| ≤ L) ∧
      (∀ j : S, j ∉ exceptionSet G color cap R L K S n x e →
        f j.val = labelBump (label G color cap R) (originalLabel G color cap x) L K j.val) ∧
      (∀ j : S, j ∉ exceptionSet G color cap R L K S n (G.move x e) (G.reverse e) →
        f j.val = -labelBump (label G color cap R) (originalLabel G color cap (G.move x e)) L K j.val) := by
  let E₁ := exceptionSet G color cap R L K S n x e
  let E₂ := exceptionSet G color cap R L K S n (G.move x e) (G.reverse e)
  let P : Set (Point G color cap R) := {j | ∃ hj : j ∈ S, (⟨j,hj⟩ : S) ∉ E₁}
  let Q : Set (Point G color cap R) := {j | ∃ hj : j ∈ S, (⟨j,hj⟩ : S) ∉ E₂}
  let b := labelBump (label G color cap R) (originalLabel G color cap x) (L : ℝ) (K : ℝ)
  let c := labelBump (label G color cap R) (originalLabel G color cap (G.move x e)) (L : ℝ) (K : ℝ)

  have hK' : 0 < (K : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hK
  have hLK' : (L : ℝ) ≤ K := by exact_mod_cast hLK
  have hb (z) : 0 ≤ b z ∧ b z ≤ L := ⟨labelBump_nonneg _ _ hL' _, labelBump_le _ _ hL' hK' _⟩
  have hc (z) : 0 ≤ c z ∧ c z ≤ L := ⟨labelBump_nonneg _ _ hL' _, labelBump_le _ _ hL' hK' _⟩
  have hcross : ∀ j ∈ P, ∀ k ∈ Q, dist j k < 2*(L : ℝ) → b j = 0 ∧ c k = 0 := by
    rintro j ⟨hj,hEj⟩ k ⟨hk,hEk⟩ hd
    have hd' : dist j k < (2*L : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast hd

Reference proof summary

Sum exceptional variation over ports: good vertices cost at most V, bad vertices at most |D|V. The cardinal hypotheses force total variation below |X||D|/10. Sum edge inequalities and use invariance under the incidence-reversal bijection to count the same total error twice, yielding a contradiction.

theorem signed_incidence_obstruction [Nonempty X] [Nonempty D]
    (μ : X → S → ℝ) (E : X → D → Set S) (bad : Finset X)
    (rev : (X × D) ≃ (X × D)) (p V : ℝ)
    (hp : 0 < p) (hV : 0 ≤ V)
    (hTV : ∀ x, totalVariation (μ x) ≤ V)
    (hgood : ∀ x, x ∉ bad → ∀ j e f, j ∈ E x e → j ∈ E x f → e = f)
    (hdegree : 20 * V < (Fintype.card D : ℝ))
    (hbad : 20 * V * (bad.card : ℝ) < (Fintype.card X : ℝ))
    (hedge : ∀ e : X × D,
      3 * (10 * p) / 2 - 2 * (10 * p) *
        (variationOn (μ e.1) (E e.1 e.2) +
         variationOn (μ (rev e).1) (E (rev e).1 (rev e).2)) ≤ 2 * p) : False := by
  classical
  let err : X × D → ℝ := fun e => variationOn (μ e.1) (E e.1 e.2)
  let a : ℝ := Fintype.card X
  let d : ℝ := Fintype.card D
  let b : ℝ := bad.card
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := X)
  have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos (α := D)
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by positivity
  have hvtx : ∀ x, (∑ e, err (x, e)) ≤ V + if x ∈ bad then d * V else 0 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ bad
    · simp only [ite_eq_left hx]
      have hsum : (∑ e, err (x, e)) ≤ d * V := by
        calc
          _ ≤ ∑ _e : D, V := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun e _ =>
            (variationOn_le (μ x) (E x e)).trans (hTV x))
          _ = _ := by simp [d]
      linarith
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hx, add_zero]
      exact (sum_variationOn_le (μ x) (E x) (hgood x hx)).trans (hTV x)
  have hsum : (∑ e, err e) ≤ a * V + b * (d * V) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ x, ∑ e, err (x, e) := Fintype.sum_prod_type _
      _ ≤ ∑ x, (V + if x ∈ bad then d * V else 0) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => hvtx x)
      _ = _ := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, a, b]
  have hsmall : 10 * (∑ e, err e) < a * d := by
    have hd' : 20 * V < d := hdegree
    have hb' : 20 * V * b < a := hbad
    have h₁ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hd' ha
    have h₂ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hb' hd
    nlinarith
  have hreverse : (∑ e, err (rev e)) = ∑ e, err e := Equiv.sum_comp rev err
  have hsumedge := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (X × D)))
    (fun e _ => hedge e)
  change (∑ e, (3 * (10 * p) / 2 - 2 * (10 * p) *
      (err e + err (rev e)))) ≤ ∑ _e : X × D, 2 * p at hsumedge
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    ← Finset.mul_sum] at hsumedge
